means: For every scored T-spin in the corpus (a T with an engine spin credit that cleared lines, inside the verified prefix, passing the reconstruction check), whether the STSD page's local shape stood around it: the lock's cells are the page's stood T (as drawn or mirrored) and every cell of the page's window around it is filled or empty as drawn. The opportunity is a full T-spin Double; every hit is followed to the next T lock to see whether the second TSD the page promises fired.
not_eligible_because: simulator output: which local shape a T went into is read off the vendored Triangle engine's boards, and nothing on the corpus side has a second implementation of it. No claim id, no badge, no figure in a report.
caveat: garbage is read as FILLED inside the window, and its hole columns are the engine's seeded-RNG columns, which disagree with the recorded ones (oracle-source.ts); a hit with garbage in its window is named in garbage_in_window for that reason. Counts only, always N / M with the denominator.
rules: opportunity: a T lock with spin "full" clearing 2 lines, at a 0-based lock index <= the verified index, whose board-before plus its cells makes exactly the rows the engine recorded clearing (the reconstruction check, counted exactly as opener-facts.json donation.check counts it)

match: the lock's cells equal the variant's T cells under one translation (mirrored: columns reflected in the window), and every other window cell is filled (a piece or garbage) or empty as the page draws it; colour is never compared; cells outside the window are not read
mirrored is tried only when as-drawn fails; a window leaving the board is no match (window_off_board)

follow-up: the page's second-TSD slot carried through every clear and garbage insertion to the next T lock, each step verified against the engine's next board; fired iff that T is the slot and a scored full TSD
controls: the same window at scored TSS, TST, mini TSS and mini TSD; ablations no_must_empty, no_roof and t_overlap at the opportunity; orientation_baseline = opportunities whose T stands up
window_rule: 0-based lock index <= 21 is in_opener (emit-opener-facts.ts's convention; emit-attack-facts.ts counts from 1)

cross_route.note: the rounds whose SDPC Spin route reached its STMB Cave (harddrop draws the STSD as that branch's next step, 3.first.cave.stsd, which no corpus round reaches as a whole board): did an STSD hit follow inside the drawn continuation? Measured, each miss with its reason; a round whose node or continuation lies past its verified prefix is named and kept out of the denominator.

continuation.note: OUR READING: harddrop draws the STSD (3.first.cave.stsd) as bag 5 of that route; at seven locks a bag with no hold, bag 5 is 0-based locks 28-34, so the continuation is the locks after the node through lock 34. An STSD hit later in the round is recorded as later_hit_lock and not counted.

rules: fragment: a key cell — the overhang over the well (basic.spin rows 1, columns 2-3): the cells every build draws as its roof piece (an L, a Z or an I); the cell under it the roof.i build draws as stack, so it is not required fresh — belongs to a piece not all four of whose cells are on the board before the T (a line clear cut it)
garbage_in_shape: a key cell is garbage
shape_cell_empty: a key cell is empty (the window requires it filled, so only a weakened window can admit this)
dpc: the board is empty after one of the 14 locks before the T, the T itself, or one of the 14 after it (the DPC setup)
ownership_unverified: a lock before the T has a row map the digest could not verify, so its pieces cannot be told apart

not_whole_shape: none of the source page's own drawings of the variant (its board and its agreement drawings) stands around the T cell for cell by occupancy, in either hand — each drawing read as the T, every enclosed hole touching it or within three rows under it, and a one-cell margin (technique-wholeshape.ts)
qualifies iff none applies; the shape stood at every hit either way
